# Environment variables

The launcher constructs each child environment. No exports are needed. Precedence is `--flag` > `env_overrides` in the config > the DSV4.1 table default > the engine default. Inherited engine settings are removed with a warning. OS identity, locale and toolchain paths keep their normal meaning.

Each row below comes from `envvars.json`, which also supplies the CLI flags and child defaults. Use `python -m slstack.envdocs --check` to verify this reference and the source inventory.

`slstack install --all` installs the pinned isolated media runtime and builds the native engines and chat UI. The UI builds before the server embeds its generated assets. Media workers use the isolated runtime automatically; an explicit `studio_python` setting still overrides that choice. `install --all --check` checks packages and build outputs without rebuilding.

## Prefill modes

`slstack rtx --mode accurate|fast|ultra|hyper` selects Studio's delivered RTX prefill arithmetic profile. The default is accurate. Image/video residency uses separate `--image-mode streaming|resident` and `--video-mode streaming|resident` flags. All four profiles use locked RAM carry with no pageable resident copy.

Accurate preserves the original default arithmetic; Fast enables the delivered BF16 indexer and split-F32 scores. Ultra also uses the delivered reduced-precision expert/dense/attention paths. Hyper adds transient FP4 weight/activation conversion on the GPU. Hyper never writes a requantized model file; selecting it explicitly opts into those arithmetic changes. These profile definitions are separate from the bias tool and do not imply a new build has passed every mode's parity or performance test.

## Quality and speed

The chat model can call `set_quality_speed` and `get_quality_speed`. The router executes these tools against the native control endpoint. Modes above Balanced are faster but may produce worse answers.

| Setting | Bias |
|---|---|
| `max_quality` | 0 |
| `balanced` | 0.35 |
| `fast` | 0.65 |
| `faster` | 0.9 |
| `max_speed` | 1.36125 |

Use `value` for one setting, or provide independent `reasoning`, `tool_call`, `answer`, `code` arguments. Partial phase updates preserve the other settings. Numeric values must be finite and in [0,1.36125].

Tool-call examples:

```json
{"name":"set_quality_speed","arguments":{"value":"balanced"}}
{"name":"set_quality_speed","arguments":{"reasoning":"fast","answer":"balanced","code":"max_quality"}}
{"name":"get_quality_speed","arguments":{}}
```

Native controls take effect at token boundaries. The response reports requested and applied values, revision, phase counters and the latest throughput window. Its scope field describes whether the backend applies the setting server-wide. An unsupported backend must report that capability explicitly. Short throughput windows are observations, not benchmark guarantees.

## Launcher settings

`runtime_min_free_gib` and `--runtime-min-free-gib` default to 0.5 GiB of available physical RAM during execution; 0 disables this floor. Admission still requires the declared host budget plus its reserve. The host RSS budget and paging stop remain enabled. Shutdown requests cooperative cancellation first, waits while diagnostics or memory reclamation advance, and allows a logged force kill only after a full quiet grace period.

| `--llamadecode-recency-lfu` | Explicit runtime value | E8 opt-in L2 expert-cache placement: 0 (default) retains LRU; 1 uses recency-weighted LFU with a 25% admission margin. Configure the score half life separately; routes and arithmetic are unchanged. |
| `--llamadecode-lfu-half-life` | Explicit runtime value | E8 experiment: LFU score half life in tokens, 1 (default) or 16. Only used when the opt-in recency-LFU policy is enabled; expert routes and arithmetic are unchanged. |

Budget placeholders use the admitted child budget: `{host_budget_bytes}`, `{host_budget_mb}`, `{physical_floor_bytes}` (admission) and `{runtime_floor_bytes}` (runtime). `{host_budget_gib}` and `{min_available_gib}` use GiB. User overrides are literal strings, including JSON and braces.

Hardware commands use the pinned shared ownership/paging guard. Model operations wait while progress advances; only stalled work expires. It enforces the physical budget/floor and a separate Windows device-backing commit allowance. Windows owned-page observations are bounded and incremental; Darwin disk-only process attribution is unavailable. Zero observed pages does not establish exhaustive zero pagefile I/O. Resource leases remain held if owned cleanup cannot be confirmed.

Examples (edit paths in the config first):

```text
slstack rtx --config config.json --llama-dsv41-topk-radix 1
slstack rtx --config config.json --ds4-cuda-streaming-expert-cache-reserve-gb 2
slstack mac --config config.json --ds4-metal-disable-v41-layer-prefill 1
slstack rtx --config config.json --mem-guard-min-free-gb 4
```

The core-eviction flag must remain 0 and the wired Metal flag must remain 1. Requests to disable these residency requirements fail before an engine starts.

### DS4_DISABLE_ENGRAM_IORING

A/B switch for the Windows Engram row reader: unset (default) reads raw rows through one IoRing per batch (DS4_ENGRAM_READER ioring); set restores the 16-thread synchronous pread reader. Both decode through the same function, so output bytes are identical.

Scope: ds4-win. Class: advanced.

Source: `engines/ds4-win/ds4_engram.c:265`. Unset read: NULL from getenv; the literal consumer below supplies any fallback.

```text
    static int enabled = -1;
    if (enabled < 0) {
        enabled = getenv("DS4_DISABLE_ENGRAM_IORING") == NULL;
        fprintf(stderr, "DS4_ENGRAM_READER %s\n", enabled ? "ioring (DS4_DISABLE_ENGRAM_IORING to use pread)" : "pread (DS4_DISABLE_ENGRAM_IORING set)");
    }
    return enabled != 0;
}
```

```text
static void glm_debug_dump_prefill_logits(const float *logits) {
    static int dumped;
    const char *path = getenv("DS4_GLM_LOGIT_DUMP");
    if (!path || !path[0] || dumped || !logits) return;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return;
    fwrite(logits, sizeof(float), (size_t)DS4_N_VOCAB, f);
```

```text
static uint32_t qwen4_mtp_draft_rows(void) {
```

```text
static bool qwen4_graph_fused(const ds4_qwen4_gpu_graph *g, uint32_t T) {
    static int no_fuse = -1;
    if (no_fuse < 0) no_fuse = getenv("DS4_QWEN4_NO_FUSE") != NULL;
    if (no_fuse || T <= 2u) return T <= 2u && !no_fuse;
    /* T = 3 takes the fused kernels for the speculative verify only; prefill
     * tails of three tokens keep their historical kernel selection. */
    return T == 3u && g->verify_rows_exact;
```

```text
static bool ggml_alloc_no_free_reuse(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) { const char * e = getenv("GGML_ALLOC_NO_FREE_REUSE"); v = (e && e[0] && e[0] != '0') ? 1 : 0; }
    return v != 0 || g_ggml_force_no_free_reuse != 0;
}
```

```text
fn curlBaseArgs(list: *std.ArrayList([]const u8), allocator: std.mem.Allocator) !?[]u8 {
```

```text
// file; the engine then stops at its next stage boundary and tears down normally.
bool abort_file_present(){
    static const wchar_t*name=_wgetenv(L"LLAMADECODE_ABORT_FILE");
    if(!name||!*name)return false;
    static std::atomic<int64_t>last{0};const int64_t now=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(clock_type::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    if(now-last.load()<250)return false;last.store(now);
    return GetFileAttributesW(name)!=INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES;
```

```text
/// so a partial download never gets handed back.
fn resolveGemmaDir(io: std.Io, allocator: std.mem.Allocator, model_dir: []const u8, version: ltx.LtxVersion) ![]u8 {
    if (std.c.getenv("LTX_GEMMA_DIR")) |env| {
        const e = std.mem.span(env);
        // A relative override would feed openFileAbsolute's assert downstream
        // (ReleaseFast UB) — ignore it loudly instead.
        if (e.len > 0 and std.fs.path.isAbsolute(e)) return allocator.dupe(u8, e);
```

```text
def load_refiner_config(repo_root: Optional[Path]=None):
```

```text
def spill_gate_blockers(request: Magi2GenerationRequest) -> list[str]:
    chunk = int(os.environ.get('MAGI2_MLP_CHUNK_TOKENS', '1024' if request.resolution in ('540p', '1080p') else '0'))
    depth = int(os.environ.get('MAGI2_RING_DEPTH', '1'))
    proj = project_peak_vram_gb(request.resolution, ring_depth=depth, mlp_chunk_tokens=chunk, seconds=request.seconds)
    if not proj['would_spill']:
        return []
    return [f"PROJECTED PEAK {proj['projected_gb']:.1f}GB EXCEEDS the {proj['ceiling_gb']:.1f}GB dedicated-VRAM ceiling -> this run WOULD SPILL into WDDM shared memory (crawls at ~0% util and starves the machine). Breakdown: ring {proj['ring_gb']:.1f}GB (depth {depth}) + fixed {proj['fixed_gb']:.1f}GB + activations {proj['activations_gb']:.1f}GB over {proj['tokens']} packed tokens. TURN A KNOB: lower MAGI2_MLP_CHUNK_TOKENS (currently {chunk}; try {max(512, chunk // 2)}), keep MAGI2_RING_DEPTH=1, drop --resolution, or raise MAGI2_SPILL_CEILING_GB only if you accept spilling."]
```

### LLAMADECODE_APPEND_RESIDENT_SWEEP

E2c default resident-expert sweep for at most32 new tokens after resident decode. Set0 for full sweeps. The owner accepted measured follow-up KL0.0000235/0.000224/0.00250 at2K/8K/32K, with recall/top1 passing and append2.7-2.9s versus17.5-18.2s. ### LLAMA_DSV41_INDEX_FP4

E6 default SM120 FP4/E8M0 MMA index scorer for the existing BF16 index profile. Set0 to retain BF16. Packs already quantized values exactly; every operation requires a conservative FP32 integer-sum certificate or falls back to original BF16 cuBLAS. At100K,prompt execution70.459 to67.746s, TTFT74.688 to71.891s,17full-vocabulary logit rows bit-identical, KL0 and retrieval pass. No stored KV change.

Scope: rtx-llama. Class: advanced.

Source: `engines/streaming-llama/prefill_llama.cpp/ggml/src/ggml-cuda/dsv41-index-fp4.cuh:74`. Unset read: NULL from getenv; the literal consumer below supplies any fallback.

```text

static bool dsv41_index_fp4(ggml_backend_cuda_context&ctx,ggml_tensor*dst){
    if(!ggml_dsv41_index_fp4_enabled(std::getenv("LLAMA_DSV41_INDEX_FP4")))return false;
    GGML_ASSERT(ggml_cuda_info().devices[ctx.device].cc==1200);
    const int tokens=int(dst->ne[1]),rows=int(dst->ne[0]),qrows=tokens*32;
    const uint64_t bytes=uint64_t(qrows+rows)*68+7*4;
    GGML_ASSERT(bytes<=64ull*1024*1024&&"FP4 index workspace exceeds existing64MiB reserve");
```
